comment: Rack's bypass passes the dry audio through rather than silencing the module (chiaroscuro.cpp:326-327). The distortion, drive and mix CV jacks read only their first channel even though the audio path is polyphonic; contrast is the exception among the distortion controls in that its single setting produces a different depth for every voice.
